### T-687 — A dev/ store directory shadows the dev intent

> _2026-11-14 · realm/blong-blob · done_

A realm whose blob store lives in `dev/blob` (`realm/blong-party/index.ts`,
`realm/blong-sport/index.ts`) grows a `dev/` directory in the package root, and the CLI reads a
positional argument that names an existing folder as a module: `npx blong dev` in that package fails
with `ERR_UNSUPPORTED_DIR_IMPORT url: file:///…/realm/blong-party/dev` instead of starting the dev
intent. `blong-dev playwright` is unaffected because it runs
`node --run blong -- microservice integration dev playwright`, whose first positional is not `dev`.
Fix by moving the store out of the package (the repository's `.gitignore`d `dev/` was a convenience,
not a requirement) or by teaching the loader that an intent name wins over a folder of the same
name.

Fixed by D-858: a target must be spelled as a path (a separator is the discriminator), so a dev/
store directory can no longer shadow the dev intent; blong dev now starts the dev intent in
realm/blong-party, pinned by core/blong-gogo/src/cliTarget.test.ts.
